decisions.quote:
We used the code and datasets published by the authors (Hussam et al., 2022b) to reproduce
the tables in their paper. We were able to reproduce all the tables in the paper, which is not
surprising given that the codes had already been checked by the American Economic Review
replication team and by the team of the Institute for Replication.
decisions.reason: Re-running the original authors' published code and datasets reproduced all reported tables in the paper, and the replicators explicitly conclude that the results are computationally reproducible; the coding error they subsequently identified and corrected in Table 4 concerns variable construction in the original script rather than a failure to reproduce the published numbers.
